payload.text: hv 2026-11-12, the 0.1.23 cut. By 14:58Z, three TUI answers for the release in another estate: its slot runs the same evening; vc pushes hv when it is green; "everyone upgraded" means the estate's own only. Cut 1 (release commit 61dbd245): local and kovacs green, candidate CI 43248401461 red on macOS alone with all 3136 ok, on bats-core 1.14.0 bats-exec-file:195 losing a reaped child's status. The resume's CI 43260195601 parked on macOS past 71 min. hv by TUI at 17:53Z: "Fix CI job count, re-cut": vc cancelled the run, the cut stopped, main was reset to ca2fe5ee (one reset, nothing public). 0340-3 landed at c53e6df7: CI runs on its runner's own CPU count again; the floor of 24 stays for hosts. Re-cut: every leg green at 7ab21982 (local 975s, kovacs 18:18:40Z to 18:41:16Z, candidate CI 43275707623 3533s, macOS the last to finish), v0.1.23 tagged and pushed, formula published, end 19:02:19Z. hv on test speed: "these test runs have blow out across the whole estate to the point where they are basically unusable"; "it's every single project that is _using_ devbin". hv ordered a root-and-branch review of the release process (socrates; ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/release-review/REVIEW.md) and its recommendations started: action 1 is dc's stack for the next release, action 2 goes to Molt's and Intent's vcs after Intent's cut, action 3 goes to hv for a ruling. vc misreported a rate from a live bats log at 15:10Z (24 a minute; the run finished in 19m41s): a run's speed is its finished time.
